summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery descriptor locals in env2llm registry

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic local variable 'descriptor' to stage-accurate names in each of the nine wrapper functions of src/koruapi/env2llm_registry.py that tuple-unpack it from _get_service and embed it in their response under the 'service_descriptor' key: registry_descriptor (env2llm_get_registry, live registry snapshot response), render_descriptor (env2llm_render_registry, rendered-document response), refresh_descriptor (env2llm_refresh_registry, regenerate/persist result), sync_descriptor (env2llm_sync_after_calibration, post-calibration sync result), desktop_descriptor (env2llm_get_desktop, desktop probe slice), validation_descriptor (env2llm_validate_calibration, calibration validation result), commands_descriptor (env2llm_list_commands, command-schema listing), uris_descriptor (env2llm_list_uris, URI index payload), mqtt_descriptor (env2llm_mqtt_status, MQTT bridge status). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'descriptor' group drops from 9 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at 1 scope, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals; no signature, return shape (the response key stays 'service_descriptor') or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, payload shape or interface change (every response still carries the 'service_descriptor' key)
No restructuring of _get_service's tuple return into a handle object (that would also dissolve the pre-existing 'service' group; minimal scope for this ticket's reported variable only)
No fix for the pre-existing 'service' shotgun-surgery group in the same file (9 scopes, same tuple-unpack double-counting; separately ticketed in planfile) or for findings in other files
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'descriptor' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every wrapper that unpacks the built service's descriptor names it after the response stage it annotates (registry snapshot, rendered document, refresh result, post-calibration sync, desktop probe, calibration validation, command listing, URI index, MQTT status); the generic name 'descriptor' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'descriptor' mutation group of exactly 9 scopes - env2llm_get_registry, env2llm_render_registry, env2llm_refresh_registry, env2llm_sync_after_calibration, env2llm_get_desktop, env2llm_validate_calibration, env2llm_list_commands, env2llm_list_uris, env2llm_mqtt_status - matching the ticket's 'spans 9 functions'; after the rename the 'descriptor' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged (67) and no new (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold (the pre-existing 'service' group at 9 scopes remains untouched).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named descriptor again and the smell report returns.
